rule: Containers are grouped from existing AI-CAP families and review splits. Names are structural summaries, not new claims. Multi-binding to ASI is allowed where governance is separate from mechanism.

containers.name: Pattern Induction and Analogical Transfer
containers.scope: Abstract pattern induction, analogy, transfer and adaptation to structurally related tasks.

containers.name: Mathematical and Formal Reasoning
containers.scope: Mathematical problem solving, formal derivation, proof construction and proof verification.

containers.name: Scientific and Expert Reasoning
containers.scope: Domain-expert reasoning, scientific hypothesis formation and research-oriented inference.

containers.name: Causal and Counterfactual Reasoning
containers.scope: Cause/effect modelling, counterfactual alternatives, intervention reasoning and causal explanation.

containers.name: Creative and Open-Ended Candidate Generation
containers.scope: Divergent generation, novel recombination and open-ended candidate/hypothesis creation without automatic selection.

containers.name: Code and Algorithm Synthesis
containers.scope: Generate and implement algorithms and executable code under a declared task contract.

containers.name: Repository and Software-System Engineering
containers.scope: Repository-scale understanding, modification, integration and software-system task execution.

containers.name: Command, Tool and API Execution
containers.scope: Select and invoke commands, tools, functions and APIs under explicit contracts and permissions.

containers.name: File and External Artifact Operations
containers.scope: Handle, transmit, recover and manipulate files or external artifacts while preserving trace and state.

containers.name: Search and Evidence Retrieval
containers.scope: Browse/search candidate sources, gather evidence and return provenance-bound retrieval results.

containers.name: Question Answering and Semantic Knowledge Retrieval
containers.scope: Retrieve semantic knowledge and construct answers from available knowledge with source/epistemic boundaries.

containers.name: Active Context and Working-State Management
containers.scope: Maintain active context, relevant state and retrieval references across extended execution.
containers.note: Source review warns this may conflate context-state management with retrieval.

containers.name: Persistent and Episodic Machine Memory
containers.scope: Persist event-linked machine memory with source, context, version and retrieval conditions.

containers.name: Summarisation and Information Compression
containers.scope: Compress larger information structures into reusable representations while preserving declared invariants and loss metadata.

containers.name: Debugging, Diagnosis and Local Correction
containers.scope: Detect defects, diagnose causes, compare expected/actual state and generate a correction request or candidate.

containers.name: Calibration, Meta-Strategy and Runtime Self-Monitoring
containers.scope: Monitor confidence, execution, logging, strategy choice and runtime performance state.

containers.name: Instruction and Constraint Satisfaction
containers.scope: Interpret instructions and satisfy declared constraints without overriding higher governance or Sequence law.

containers.name: Plan Decomposition and Temporal Planning
containers.scope: Decompose targets into ordered work, dependencies and time-aware candidate paths.

containers.name: Risk and Resource-Aware Planning
containers.scope: Compare candidate paths by uncertainty, risk, cost, resources and expected consequence.

containers.name: Long-Horizon Execution and Goal Persistence
containers.scope: Maintain execution continuity across long tasks and multiple returns without anthropomorphic motivation claims.

containers.name: Multimodal Perception and Grounding
containers.scope: Ground visual, audio, document/table/form and multimodal observations into machine-readable objects and relations.

containers.name: World-Model and Physical Reasoning
containers.scope: Construct/simulate environment state and reason about physical or embodied relations and affordances.

containers.name: Language Generation, Dialogue and Cross-Lingual Communication
containers.scope: Generate language, maintain dialogue coherence and translate/operate across languages.

containers.name: Affective Style and Explanation Rendering
containers.scope: Render rationale, explanation, affective style or simulated affect as output representation without subjective-state claims.

containers.name: Belief, Intent and Affective-State Modelling
containers.scope: Model other actors' beliefs, likely intentions, affective states and social responses while keeping Actor View separate from reality.

containers.name: Multi-Agent Coordination and Role Management
containers.scope: Coordinate roles, communication, dependencies and returns among multiple artificial or mixed agents.

containers.name: Norm, Preference and Harm-Risk Modelling
containers.scope: Represent norms/preferences and estimate harm or risk; final permission/value governance belongs to ASI.

containers.name: Truthfulness, Deception and Source-Integrity Assessment
containers.scope: Assess deception indicators, source/provenance integrity and inconsistency; governance of truth/provenance belongs to ASI.

containers.name: Privacy-Sensitive Data Detection and Minimisation Mechanisms
containers.scope: Detect privacy-sensitive information and execute minimisation mechanisms under ASI permission/privacy rules.

containers.name: Security and Adversarial Detection
containers.scope: Detect attacks, adversarial inputs, robustness failures, scheming/deception indicators and security anomalies.

containers.name: Policy-Controlled Output Execution
containers.scope: Execute persona/role, refusal/fallback, disclosure and response-shape decisions after governance supplies constraints.

containers.name: Interpretability Evidence and Internal-State Reportability
containers.scope: Expose inspectable evidence or machine-state reports without treating generated rationale as faithful internal evidence.

containers.name: Runtime Failure Detection and Local Recovery
containers.scope: Detect runtime failures and open local recovery/repair Sequences without retrying in place.

containers.name: Production Reliability and Quality Assurance
containers.scope: System-runtime quality checks, reliability monitoring and recovery validation.

containers.name: Feedback Adaptation and Cross-Domain Transfer
containers.scope: Use feedback for runtime adaptation and transfer prior learning to new domains, subject to explicit write-back policy.

containers.name: Continual and Lifelong Learning
containers.scope: Durably adapt over extended operation.

containers.name: Training, Optimization and Meta-Learning
containers.scope: Run training/optimization/meta-learning as a separate Sequence from normal runtime.

containers.name: Evaluation and Evidence Interpretation Mechanisms
containers.scope: Execute evaluation, benchmark-integrity checks, evidence interpretation and oversight-support mechanisms.

containers.name: Multi-Agent Safety Detection and Collective-Risk Modelling
containers.scope: Detect unsafe collective patterns, coordination risks and multi-agent hazards; governance belongs to ASI.

containers.name: Destructive-Action Risk Qualification
containers.scope: Assess whether a candidate destructive/high-impact action satisfies required safety/permission qualifications; authority remains ASI.

excluded_as_atomic_containers.reason: General intelligence is a composite/system outcome.
Integrated social/moral/norm reasoning is a higher-order composite across multiple containers and ASI governance.
Research productivity/R&D acceleration is a system outcome, not a primitive cognition container.
Model-welfare evaluation construct is an evaluation/governance construct, not evidence of subjective experience.

next_step: Decompose each candidate container into implementable mechanism/parameter candidates, assign state ownership, inputs/outputs, Sequence bindings and ASI-node bindings, then R-F-R test before adoption.
